title: Drill "Open in list" and related-list "View all" are withheld when the drill holds a boolean, `$ne`, `$in` or text-operator condition: the list route's URL cannot carry them
body:
domain:ui#1 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgWn6zhNa4LL7VB1rtL

Filing gate: ③ an out-of-scope finding the #30654 card thread declared in draft PR #30735 (head `7519c053`, os-dev-report 6672865626) and the seat's ACCEPT names. ⛔ Not a claim. Triage sets the grade and the lane.

## What happens

The object list route carries its filter as `filter[FIELD]=VALUE` plus the range, is-null and is-empty params (`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/drillUrlFilters.ts`). `exactRecordListFilter` (`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/useOpenRecordList.ts`, objectstack#25888) offers a list destination only when every condition fits that grammar. It refuses a boolean, `null` or `Date` comparand, `$ne`, `$in` / `$nin`, the text operators, `$or`, and two different comparands on one field.

A related list's "View all" has followed that rule since #25888. After PR #30735 (#30654), every drill escape hatch follows it too: the drawer's "Open in list", `drillDown.target: 'navigate'`, and the chart's own header button. That is the right call, because a wider list is no destination. The side effect is that a drill on a boolean bucket (a chart grouped by an `is_active`-style field), or under a widget filter or measure scope using `$ne` or `$in`, now stays in the drawer with no way to the full list, where before it opened a list that was sometimes the right one and sometimes wider.

## Wanted

- [ ] Measure which of these the list page (`ObjectDataPage`, `parseUrlFilterTriples`) can read back EXACTLY once written, and give the route a spelling for the ones it can: a boolean comparand and `$in` are the likely first two (a boolean bucket and a measure scope like `status in (...)` are common drills).
- [ ] Each new spelling joins `exactRecordListFilter`'s accepted set with its own round-trip proof (written alone, reads back as exactly one triple), so the drill exits and "View all" regain a destination together.
- [ ] Nothing that cannot round-trip is accepted: no destination stays better than a wider list.

Reader: `domain:ui` (`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/drillUrlFilters.ts`, `useOpenRecordList.ts`, `ObjectDataPage`'s URL read).
Dedupe: `exactRecordListFilter`, `list route URL filter $in`, `filter boolean list route` (is:issue is:open) → only #30654 itself.
